name: writing-html-copy
description: Writes and reviews clear, specific text for HTML pages. Use whenever creating, redesigning, or editing a web page that includes human-readable copy, even when the request is to build the page rather than write text. Covers landing pages, homepages, pricing pages, product pages, dashboards, HTML artifacts, headings, hero text, feature descriptions, buttons, and UI microcopy in HTML, Blade, JSX, TSX, Vue, Svelte, or Markdown rendered on the web. Not for code-only changes that leave copy untouched or prose outside web pages.
